messages:
maya: Quick sync— finalizing validation and confirmation patterns for the new settings form (8+ fields, advanced collapsibles, and a final destructive cleanup step). Thoughts?

trent: Hybrid approach still wins for me. Lightweight inline hints on blur + a form-level summary on submit. Keep immediate blockers (like password complexity) visible as the user types though.

lucy: Agree. Password strength is a special case: show a non-blocking strength meter + checklist (length, number, symbol). Only mark as error on submit if requirements aren't met. Avoid red while typing.

omar: Collapsed sections: show a tiny error pill on the section header like "1 issue" so users know without expanding. On submit auto-expand the first errored section but do NOT steal focus. Smooth animation only.

maya: What about required markers? Asterisk alone fails SR users. Proposal: visible asterisk + visually-hidden text '(required)' or inline label like "Email (required)" for key fields.

lucy: prefer inline label for critical fields, allow asterisk for compact tables. Ensure a11y text is in DOM (not just tooltip).

trent: Copy for form banner: "Fix 2 issues to continue" vs "Please fix the following issues"? I like the shorter: "Fix 2 issues to continue." Shows action + count.

omar: Agree. Use aria-live="assertive" when the user submits and fails; for incremental updates aria-live="polite". Also link the summary items to fields with anchor IDs and aria-describedby.

maya: Destructive step: we have 'Purge logs and snapshots (permanent)'. Options: 1) typed-confirm, 2) modal + undo, 3) consent checkbox + CTA. Thoughts?

lucy: For permanent customer data => typed-confirm. For purging ephemeral logs => modal + toast undo is friendlier. Consent checkbox is weak alone. If using checkbox, pair with modal that repeats the risk.

trent: Technical note: undo requires soft-delete + reconciliation worker. If infra isn't ready, default to typed-confirm for everything until Phase 2. We should document phases.

omar: Microcopy for typed-confirm: "Type PURGE to permanently delete 'project-name'". Show the name in monospace and add a one-line consequence. Add a small copy link: "Why is this irreversible?" that expands details.

maya: Accessibility for typed-confirm: trap focus, aria-labelledby to announce purpose, aria-describedby for consequences, and ensure the input has aria-label. Also don't rely on color or icon alone.

lucy: UX nit: when users tab through fields and inline errors appear on blur, avoid auto-jumping to a summary or first error — it breaks flow. Only change focus on explicit submit or when user clicks the banner.

trent: Error density rule: if >4 errors, collapse the list under "Show all issues" and surface the top 3 with links. Prevents overwhelm in bad states.

omar: Mobile: sticky bottom CTA that shows an error badge (e.g., red dot + count). Banner might be off-screen; the badge solves that.

maya: Edge case: async validation for uniqueness (name taken). Debounce 400-600ms, show inline spinner + message 'Checking availability...'. If unavailable, show suggestion copy like "Try 'proj-name-1'".

lucy: Tests to add: keyboard-only flow, screen reader announcement of summary and per-field errors, mobile sticky CTA visibility, collapsed-section pill behavior, typed-confirm SR behavior, and debounce timing for async checks.

trent: Acceptance criteria for RFC: 1) Hybrid validation implemented (blur hints + summary on submit), 2) Password strength meter + checklist, 3) Collapsed headers show issue pills and auto-expand-on-submit, 4) Typed-confirm for irreversible deletes, modal+undo for ephemeral deletes (or Phase 2 scheduling), 5) ARIA attributes in spec (live regions, aria-invalid, aria-describedby).

omar: I'll mock the typed-confirm dialog, mobile sticky CTA, and collapsed-header pill in Figma and post links.

maya: I'll author the RFC with phased rollout and include copy samples + acceptance criteria. Assign dev owners and note backend work for undo.

aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: include automated tests for aria-live announcements and ensure color contrast of error text >= 4.5:1. Also include focus-return behavior after dialog close.

lucy: tiny copy tweak: use "Fix 2 issues to continue" as banner text and for individual items use verbs: "Enter a valid email", "Password must include a symbol" — short imperatives help.

maya: OK, consensus: hybrid + special password handling + clear typed-confirm policy for irreversible actions + mobile sticky CTA + phased undo infra. I'll circulate the RFC draft tomorrow.

trent: :thumbsup: thanks all.
